item.title: Version 0.35
item.description:
New: Open UTF-8 text, JSON, and source-code files with Command-O, including files with uncommon extensions. Source files receive appropriate syntax highlighting.

New: Adjust editor text size with Command-Plus, Command-Minus, and Command-0. Your preference persists between launches.

Improved: More reliable opening and retry behavior for iCloud, pCloud, and other File Provider files, with safer file-type detection and clean rejection of invalid text.

If the installer fails, please download the latest version manually from markjason.sh
